headline: A single thread collecting risk and technical assessments of syrupUSDC on Aave X Layer.
summary: This thread is the home for risk and technical assessments of Syrup USDC (syrupUSDC) on Aave X Layer. It is to hold the pre-listing asset risk assessment under the Aave Risk Framework, the pre-listing technical assessment under the Technical Asset Listing Framework, and later post-listing monitoring reports, periodic refreshes and re-evaluations triggered by material changes. New assessments will be posted as replies. The opening post itself contains no parameters, amounts or findings, so there is nothing to evaluate yet; open questions depend on the assessments that follow.
